paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : Informativeness and missing step values of 4 representative LLMs
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between an x-axis variable and “Missing Step,” represented on the y-axis. The x-axis is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4 with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.835 to 0.850, with tick labels at intervals of 0.005.  A dashed blue line, labeled “0-CoT”, begins at (0, 0.847) and decreases to (4, 0.837).  At x=1, the line has a value of approximately 0.844, at x=2 it is approximately 0.841, and at x=3 it is 0.834. An orange solid line, labeled “CoRe”, starts at (0, 0.849) and declines to (4, 0.839). At x=1, the line has a value of approximately 0.846, at x=2 its value is approximately 0.843, and at x=3 it is 0.841.
